```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,
                      fig.align="center")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(pheatmap)
library(DT)

p        <- params
out      <- p$out_dir
padj_thr <- p$padj_threshold
lfc_thr  <- p$lfc_threshold
de_dir   <- file.path(out, "comparison_ChaRNA_interaction", "deseq2")

safe_read <- function(f, ...) {
  if (file.exists(f)) tryCatch(read.delim(f, ...), error=function(e) NULL)
  else NULL
}

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
int_sig   <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "genes_fractionChaRNA_phasemitosis_DE_significant.tsv"))
int_full  <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "genes_fractionChaRNA_phasemitosis_DE.tsv"))

# ── Gene name lookup (from integrated gene_type_map) ──────────────────────────
gene_map_int <- safe_read(file.path(out, "integrated/gene_type_map.tsv"))
gene_names_int <- if (!is.null(gene_map_int) && all(c("gene_id","gene_name") %in% colnames(gene_map_int))) {
  setNames(gene_map_int$gene_name, sub("\\..*", "", gene_map_int$gene_id))
} else character(0)
label_gene_int <- function(ids) {
  ids_base <- sub("\\..*", "", ids)
  nm <- gene_names_int[ids_base]
  ifelse(!is.na(nm) & nzchar(nm), nm, ids_base)
}
phase_all <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "genes_phasemitosisvsinterphase_DE.tsv"))
te_int    <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "TE_fractionChaRNA_phasemitosis_DE.tsv"))
te_phase  <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "TE_phase_mitosis_vs_interphase_DE.tsv"))
sat_int   <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "satellite_fractionChaRNA_phasemitosis_DE.tsv"))
norm_counts <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "normalized_counts.tsv"), row.names=1)

# PCA — fix duplicate "PC1" column name
pca_raw <- safe_read(file.path(de_dir, "pca_coordinates.tsv"))
if (!is.null(pca_raw)) {
  cn <- colnames(pca_raw)
  dup <- which(duplicated(cn))
  cn[dup] <- paste0(cn[dup], "_2")
  colnames(pca_raw) <- cn
  # rename to expected names: sample_id, PC1, PC2, fraction, phase
  pca_coords <- pca_raw |>
    rename(any_of(c(PC2="PC1_2", fraction="PC1_2"))) |>
    select(sample_id, PC1, PC2=any_of(c("PC1_2","PC2")),
           fraction=any_of(c("fraction","PC1_2")),
           phase=any_of(c("phase"))) |>
    distinct()
  # fallback: col 1=sample_id, 2=PC1, 3=PC2, 4=fraction, 5=phase
  if (ncol(pca_raw) >= 5) {
    pca_coords <- data.frame(
      sample_id = pca_raw[[1]],
      PC1       = as.numeric(pca_raw[[2]]),
      PC2       = as.numeric(pca_raw[[3]]),
      fraction  = pca_raw[[4]],
      phase     = pca_raw[[5]],
      PC1_var   = if (ncol(pca_raw)>=6) pca_raw[[6]] else NA,
      PC2_var   = if (ncol(pca_raw)>=7) pca_raw[[7]] else NA
    )
  }
}

# Colours
col_frac  <- c(ChaRNA="#1A5276", totRNA="#7FB3D3")
col_phase <- c(interphase="#27AE60", mitosis="#E74C3C")
col_up    <- "#E74C3C"; col_dn <- "#3498DB"; col_ns <- "#BDC3C7"
```

# Biological Context

This report presents results from a **DESeq2 interaction model** (`~ fraction + phase + fraction:phase`) applied to 12 RNA-seq samples covering two fractions and two cell-cycle phases:

| Group | Fraction | Phase | n |
|-------|----------|-------|---|
| ChaRNA | Chromatin-associated RNA | Interphase | 3 |
| mito-ChaRNA | Chromatin-associated RNA | Mitosis | 3 |
| totRNA | Total RNA | Interphase | 3 |
| mito-totRNA | Total RNA | Mitosis | 3 |

**Coefficient of interest — `fraction[ChaRNA]:phase[mitosis]`**: tests whether the effect of mitosis on transcript levels differs between the ChaRNA and totRNA fractions.
A **significant positive** interaction (LFC > 0) means a gene is *more enriched* in chromatin-associated RNA during mitosis than expected from its overall transcriptional change.
A **significant negative** interaction (LFC < 0) means a gene is *depleted* from chromatin during mitosis beyond the global decrease.

Reference: `totRNA` fraction, `interphase` phase.

# QC

## PCA

```{r pca-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
if (!is.null(pca_coords)) {
  pc1v <- if (!is.na(pca_coords$PC1_var[1])) paste0("PC1 (", pca_coords$PC1_var[1], "%)") else "PC1"
  pc2v <- if (!is.na(pca_coords$PC2_var[1])) paste0("PC2 (", pca_coords$PC2_var[1], "%)") else "PC2"

  ggplot(pca_coords, aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=fraction, shape=phase, label=sample_id)) +
    geom_point(size=5, alpha=0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=3.2, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=col_frac) +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c(interphase=16, mitosis=17)) +
    labs(title="PCA — all 12 samples (top 500 most variable genes)",
         x=pc1v, y=pc2v, color="Fraction", shape="Phase") +
    theme_minimal(base_size=13) +
    theme(legend.position="right")
} else cat("PCA data not available.\n")
```

## Sample Correlation

```{r corr-heatmap, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
if (!is.null(norm_counts) && ncol(norm_counts) >= 2) {
  nc_log  <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts) + 1)
  cor_mat <- cor(nc_log, method="pearson")

  # Build annotation from pca_coords
  if (!is.null(pca_coords)) {
    ann_df <- data.frame(
      Fraction = pca_coords$fraction[match(colnames(cor_mat), pca_coords$sample_id)],
      Phase    = pca_coords$phase[match(colnames(cor_mat), pca_coords$sample_id)],
      row.names = colnames(cor_mat)
    )
    ann_colors <- list(Fraction=col_frac, Phase=col_phase)
  } else {
    ann_df <- NA; ann_colors <- list()
  }

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    color=colorRampPalette(c("#2C3E50","#85C1E9","white"))(100),
    annotation_col = ann_df,
    annotation_row = ann_df,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    display_numbers=TRUE, number_format="%.3f", fontsize_number=8,
    main="Sample-sample Pearson correlation (log2 normalised counts)"
  )
} else cat("Normalised counts not available.\n")
```

# Interaction Results: ChaRNA-specific Changes During Mitosis

> **Coefficient**: `fractionChaRNA:phasemitosis`
> Significant = padj < `r padj_thr`, |shrunk LFC| > `r lfc_thr`

```{r interaction-summary}
n_sig  <- if (!is.null(int_sig))  nrow(int_sig)  else 0
n_full <- if (!is.null(int_full)) nrow(int_full) else 0
n_up   <- if (!is.null(int_sig))  sum(int_sig$log2FoldChange > 0, na.rm=TRUE) else 0
n_dn   <- n_sig - n_up

cat(sprintf(
  "Genes tested: %s | Significant: %d (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f) | Up: %d | Down: %d\n",
  format(n_full, big.mark=","), n_sig, padj_thr, lfc_thr, n_up, n_dn
))
```

## Volcano Plot

```{r volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
if (!is.null(int_full) && nrow(int_full) > 0) {
  lfc_cap <- 12
  vdf <- int_full |>
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >  lfc_thr ~ "Up in ChaRNA-mitosis",
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr ~ "Down in ChaRNA-mitosis",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      lfc_plot = pmax(-lfc_cap, pmin(lfc_cap, log2FoldChange)),
      capped   = abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_cap,
      gene_label = ifelse(sig != "NS" & !is.na(gene_id),
                          label_gene_int(gene_id), NA_character_)
    )

  ggplot(vdf, aes(x=lfc_plot, y=-log10(pvalue+1e-300), color=sig)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape=capped), alpha=0.5, size=1.2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=gene_label), size=2.8, max.overlaps=25,
                              na.rm=TRUE, show.legend=FALSE,
                              box.padding=0.35, min.segment.length=0.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(
      "Up in ChaRNA-mitosis"   = col_up,
      "Down in ChaRNA-mitosis" = col_dn,
      "NS" = col_ns
    )) +
    scale_shape_manual(values=c("FALSE"=16, "TRUE"=17),
                       labels=c("FALSE"="normal","TRUE"=sprintf("|LFC|>%d (capped)", lfc_cap)),
                       name=NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(padj_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-lfc_cap, lfc_cap)) +
    labs(title="Interaction term: fractionChaRNA:phasemitosis",
         subtitle=sprintf("Gene symbols shown for significant hits (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f)", padj_thr, lfc_thr),
         x=sprintf("log2FC (interaction, capped at ±%d)", lfc_cap),
         y="-log10(p-value)", color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(legend.position="top")
} else cat("Interaction results not available.\n")
```

## Significant Genes Table

```{r sig-table}
if (!is.null(int_sig) && nrow(int_sig) > 0) {
  tbl <- int_sig |>
    mutate(
      gene_id_base = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id),
      gene_name    = label_gene_int(gene_id),
      LFC_shrunk   = round(log2FoldChange_shrunk, 3),
      LFC_raw      = round(log2FoldChange, 3),
      padj_fmt     = formatC(padj, digits=3, format="g"),
      Direction    = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "↑ ChaRNA-mitosis", "↓ ChaRNA-mitosis")
    ) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    select(`Gene name`=gene_name, `Gene ID`=gene_id_base,
           `LFC (shrunk)`=LFC_shrunk, `LFC (raw)`=LFC_raw,
           padj=padj_fmt, Direction, baseMean)

  DT::datatable(tbl,
    caption=sprintf("%d genes with significant ChaRNA-specific change in mitosis (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f)",
                    nrow(tbl), padj_thr, lfc_thr),
    options=list(pageLength=20, scrollX=TRUE, dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
    extensions="Buttons", rownames=FALSE
  ) |> DT::formatStyle("Direction",
    color=DT::styleEqual(c("↑ ChaRNA-mitosis","↓ ChaRNA-mitosis"),
                          c(col_up, col_dn)))
} else cat("No significant interaction genes at current thresholds.\n")
```

## Expression Heatmap — Significant Genes

```{r interaction-heatmap, fig.height=8, fig.width=9}
if (!is.null(int_sig) && nrow(int_sig) > 0 && !is.null(norm_counts)) {
  sig_ids <- int_sig$gene_id[int_sig$gene_id %in% rownames(norm_counts)]
  if (length(sig_ids) > 0) {
    mat <- log2(as.matrix(norm_counts[sig_ids, , drop=FALSE]) + 1)
    mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))   # Z-score per gene
    mat_z[is.nan(mat_z)] <- 0

    rownames(mat_z) <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(mat_z))

    ann_col <- if (!is.null(pca_coords)) {
      data.frame(
        Fraction = pca_coords$fraction[match(colnames(mat_z), pca_coords$sample_id)],
        Phase    = pca_coords$phase[match(colnames(mat_z), pca_coords$sample_id)],
        row.names = colnames(mat_z)
      )
    } else NA

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat_z,
      color=colorRampPalette(c("#2471A3","white","#C0392B"))(100),
      annotation_col=ann_col,
      annotation_colors=list(Fraction=col_frac, Phase=col_phase),
      cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=TRUE,
      show_rownames=TRUE, show_colnames=TRUE,
      fontsize_row=8, fontsize_col=9,
      main=sprintf("Z-score expression — %d significant interaction genes", length(sig_ids))
    )
  }
} else cat("Heatmap not available.\n")
```

# Phase Effect (Marginal: Averaged Across Fractions)

> **Coefficient**: `phasemitosis` — overall effect of mitosis regardless of fraction.

```{r phase-summary}
if (!is.null(phase_all)) {
  n_phase_sig <- sum(phase_all$padj < padj_thr & abs(phase_all$log2FoldChange) > lfc_thr,
                     na.rm=TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Genes tested: %s | Significant: %d (padj<%.2f, |LFC|>%.1f)\n",
              format(nrow(phase_all), big.mark=","), n_phase_sig, padj_thr, lfc_thr))
}
```

```{r phase-volcano, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=7}
if (!is.null(phase_all) && nrow(phase_all) > 0) {
  lfc_cap2 <- 12
  vdf2 <- phase_all |>
    mutate(
      sig = case_when(
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange >  lfc_thr ~ "Up in mitosis",
        padj < padj_thr & log2FoldChange < -lfc_thr ~ "Down in mitosis",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      lfc_plot   = pmax(-lfc_cap2, pmin(lfc_cap2, log2FoldChange)),
      gene_label = ifelse(sig != "NS" & !is.na(gene_id),
                          label_gene_int(gene_id), NA_character_)
    )

  ggplot(vdf2, aes(x=lfc_plot, y=-log10(pvalue+1e-300), color=sig)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.4, size=1) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=gene_label), size=2.5, max.overlaps=20,
                              na.rm=TRUE, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("Up in mitosis"=col_up,
                                 "Down in mitosis"=col_dn, NS=col_ns)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-lfc_cap2, lfc_cap2)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=c(-lfc_thr, lfc_thr), linetype="dashed", color="grey40") +
    labs(title="Phase effect (averaged across ChaRNA + totRNA)",
         x="log2FC (mitosis / interphase)", y="-log10(p-value)", color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(legend.position="top")
}
```

# Transposable Elements — Interaction

> TE families with a ChaRNA-specific change in mitosis.
> **Note:** Only 2 significant TE families (MER57E3 and Looper) pass the interaction threshold (padj<0.05). This is a real biological result: the stringent interaction model (`fraction:phase`) corrects for multiple testing across ~999 TE families. MER57E3 (DNA transposon, hAT superfamily) and Looper (Merlin family) showing ChaRNA-specific depletion during mitosis may reflect selective chromatin eviction of these TE-containing regions during cell division.

```{r te-interaction-table}
if (!is.null(te_int) && nrow(te_int) > 0) {
  te_sig <- te_int |>
    filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr) |>
    mutate(LFC=round(log2FoldChange_shrunk, 3),
           padj_fmt=formatC(padj, digits=3, format="g")) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    select(Family=family_id, LFC, padj=padj_fmt, baseMean)

  if (nrow(te_sig) > 0) {
    DT::datatable(te_sig,
      caption=sprintf("%d TE families with significant ChaRNA-specific change in mitosis",
                      nrow(te_sig)),
      options=list(pageLength=15, scrollX=TRUE, dom="Bfrtip", buttons=c("csv","excel")),
      extensions="Buttons", rownames=FALSE)
  } else {
    cat("No TE families with significant interaction at current thresholds.\n")
  }
} else cat("TE interaction results not available.\n")
```

```{r te-int-plot, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
if (!is.null(te_int) && nrow(te_int) > 0) {
  te_df <- te_int |>
    mutate(sig = !is.na(padj) & padj < padj_thr)

  ggplot(te_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(pvalue+1e-300),
                    color=sig, label=ifelse(sig, family_id, NA))) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.6, size=2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size=2.8, na.rm=TRUE, max.overlaps=15, show.legend=FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("TRUE"=col_up, "FALSE"=col_ns),
                       labels=c("TRUE"="Significant","FALSE"="NS")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="grey50") +
    labs(title="TE families — interaction term (ChaRNA-specific in mitosis)",
         x="log2FC (interaction)", y="-log10(p-value)", color=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12)
}
```
